sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN date_diff('day', received_at, decided_at) <= 3 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 1) AS within_3_days_pct FROM caseflow.cases WHERE decided_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01'
explanation: The share of October 2026 decisions made within 3 days of receipt.
